evidence_requirement: The primary parent itself must be supported; a partial mapping means known parent, unknown child, not weak evidence.
auxiliary_rule: Auxiliary labels may accompany a supported primary parent; never qualify a Trace alone.
no_primary_action: retain annotations; matching_status=no_primary_match; do not export as eligible; never force a primary match
counting_unit: unique parent requirement per Episode; local exports must belong to an eligible Episode

review_threshold_proposal.action: review evidence and episode boundary, never truncate automatically

work_object_policy: Split normalized source_work_object on ；. Multiple candidates require case-specific selection, never auto-union all candidates.
